explicitCanon: Local source protagonist old enough for retirement and painful knee/shoulder; memoir illustrator wrongly lengthened his legs.
Exactly seven retained artifacts with nineteen aliases; there is only one sword, one cloak, one circlet, one cup, one buckle, one spectacles pair and one token.
Artifact magic supplied by living wielder; token inert/closed, no autonomous glow or portal.
Sword has dark groove and crescent nick near tip; grip bootlace; warming cup is clay with chipped yellow rim, not gold.
visualInterpretation: Older short stocky man around seventy, fair weathered skin, broad rounded nose, balding crown with white hair at sides and bushy white eyebrows, small neat white moustache; restrained distinct design.
Everyday moss-gray wool jacket/waistcoat, cream shirt, brown trousers, practical boots; no youthful armor or royal robe.
Two body views in ordinary clothes; separate dark hooded cloak gear detail avoids false complete invisibility. Late office daylight warm cream and muted violet shadow.

Heading 'Barnaby Greave'. Elderly retired male adventurer around seventy, SHORT STOCKY body and normal short legs, slight comfortable paunch, pale weathered skin, broad rounded nose, balding crown with short white hair only at sides, bushy white brows, small neat WHITE MOUSTACHE. Mild stiff knee posture, alert vain expression, not frail fantasy wizard. Everyday moss-gray wool jacket and waistcoat with inside pocket, cream shirt, brown trousers, worn brown boots. No armor or jewels. Left half TWO same-scale full-body views: front three-quarter and rear three-quarter, same older man and clothes. He may carry a modest battered grocery trolley with lid in one view because it is his actual personal transport gear, no floor around it. Right upper two close head expressions 'Dignified' and 'Put out', SAME elderly balding/moustached face. Right/lower organize SEVEN distinct personal artifacts with enough space and brief labels: (1) ONE single ordinary straight sword, dark groove down blade, visible crescent notch near TIP, bootlace-wrapped grip; use cover solely for correct geometry, matte painted iron not photo. (2) Folded dark hooded cloak with darn at shoulder and exposed split lining at hips, no invisibility effect. (3) Plain copper circlet green at joints, one cracked joint, no gems. (4) Squat CLAY cup with CHIPPED YELLOW rim, never gold. (5) Small lifting buckle attached to original braided strap. (6) Spectacles with one lens held by wire and other by dark hardened paste. (7) Small inert smooth-edged metal token in paper sleeve, scratched marks, no glow/portal. The sword's four names are aliases of ONE sword, do not make four blades. Artifacts should not overpower body views, simplify fine detail into broad painted form. Ordinary personal objects with zero magical light. Do not add chair, table, desk or room. Entire figures/gear uncropped.
